status: prospective structural gate before any numeric height values

allowed_nonvertical_operations: count rows per individual and night
forbidden_operations: select individuals or species using height

session_definition.rule: If source timestamp contains a non-midnight time-of-day, define nocturnal session as calendar date after subtracting 12 hours; if all parsed timestamps are date-only/midnight, use the raw calendar date.
session_definition.rationale: The source paper reports nightly 20:00-06:00 GPS operation. The deterministic 12-hour shift keeps an evening-to-morning bout in one night while avoiding an artificial shift when the archived field is date-only.

presence_qualified_row: nonblank id, timestamp, longitude, latitude and height presence; height magnitude remains unread

structural_gate.decision: PASS if at least 5 individuals have at least two >=50-fix nights

species_mapping_gate.status: must be resolved outcome-blind before any vertical validation
species_mapping_gate.rule: do not pool the two species in one exchangeability cohort unless a separately frozen analysis explicitly models species; preferentially validate within species
species_mapping_gate.next_step_if_structure_passes: resolve individual-to-species mapping from source metadata, supplements, or deterministic documented ID convention without numeric height

future_validation_boundary: Passing this structural gate does not authorize reading numeric height until species mapping and a full vertical estimator contract are frozen.
Failure may not be rescued by lowering the >=50-fix threshold within this prospective family.
No height-based subset or alternative session definition may be chosen after this gate.
